prompt_strategy.value: For the practice round, the other user recommended "tom" and "jerry", which was fairly easy to recall. For the second round, that became a bit more difficult. We decided to look at the individual pieces of each figurine and identify the colors. For the first few, we could rely on the direction that their top pieces pointed (left or right). As it got more complex, we looked at other pieces of the figurines, like the shapes and colors that made them unique.

Please use at least 200 characters.

prompt_mistake.name: mistake
prompt_mistake.prompt:
# Describe the reasons for any mistakes

Did you make any mistakes in remembering the names you gave to the images?

If so, please describe what you think caused them. For example, typos, mixing up similar images, etc. 

If you didn't make any mistakes, you can type "none".
